suggested_requirements.text: The system shall allow the user to undo up to 1000 previous actions.
The system shall allow the user to redo up to 1000 previous actions.
The system shall count and display the time spent playing.
The system shall count and display the number of user actions.
The system shall record the score (time and action count) associated with a user name.
The system shall display a window containing all player scores.
The system shall display a main window containing a game board and a menu bar.
The system shall allow the user to select a block via a left mouse click.
The system shall allow the user to deselect a block via a left mouse click.
The system shall allow the user to move blocks using mouse movement.
The system shall prevent blocks from overlapping or exiting the game zone.
The system shall maintain a minimum distance of 0.05x between blocks during movement.
The system shall display a finish window when the great square is moved to the bottom of the board.
The system shall record player statistics in a file.
The system shall allow the user to erase all statistics via menu selection.
The system shall allow the user to open a previously saved game file.
The system shall allow the user to save the current game state to a file.
The system shall prompt the user to save the game upon exit if the game has not been saved.
The system shall provide a graphical display of at least 800x600 resolution.
The system shall be built using the Qt graphical library.
The system shall be portable to the Windows OS.
The system shall support only one user per machine.
The system shall use a keyboard and mouse for user input.
